messages.text:
Please begin work on v2

[2 private attachments omitted]

Verified against the live ledger instead of running on the pasted log. It holds up closely — one wording discrepancy worth flagging, and one thing the pasted log implies is open but the ledger says is already ratified.

**What's actually ratified** (D109, D110 — both `OWNER-RATIFIED`, confirmed in DECISIONS.md): NativeWholeField is the selected v2 architecture. Transformer = matched baseline / diagnostic / bounded voice-decoder only, never backbone. CSLv4 = reasoning/spec projection, NIL = typed cognition/state/effect IR, CSSLv4 = executable substrate, CSLv3/CSSLv3 = compatibility/oracle lineage. Seed-1 is defined (no Transformer block, must snapshot/replay/rollback exactly).

One flag: D109's logged `OWNER DIRECTIVE` field reads *"Proceed until Apocv2 is ready, on a VM, to converse with"* — not the "at v1" phrasing shown in your pasted log. Probably the same instruction canonicalized, but naming it since exact wording matters on a ratified decision.

**What's frozen but not closed** (D111→D113, D113 is latest/current): D111 froze the V20 evidence contracts — 195-file source lineage, 48-row v1 parity denominator (42 PARTIAL / 6 OPEN / 0 COMPLETE). D112 preregistered the tournament (A0 Transformer, A0E byte/event diagnostic, A1 FederatedRecurrentBlackboard, A2–4 native ablations, A5 full NativeWholeField) as `PREREGISTRATION-SKELETON · NO-EXECUTION`. D113, written after an adversarial audit found real gaps in the first draft, is explicit: **execution/training/spend/deployment/network/effects = false, right now**, and every phase needs its own separate lease/activation receipt — that's the whole point of D113, closing the exact failure mode where one authorization gets read as unlocking everything downstream. V20/G00/G09/G13 are all still OPEN/RED.

**The actual next gate — specs/68, V20 Owner Acceptance Packet rev.0:** `PROPOSAL-ONLY · OWNER-SIGNATURE-OPEN`. This is the literal next dependency — the parity artifact's own `next_dependency` field names it. Nothing in v2 moves past it. The packet's own rule: silence, continued work, or repo access don't count as acceptance. Only this does:

> I, RIGHTS_HOLDER, ratify specs/68 rev.0 as written.

— or you name the exact clauses to change. So: "please begin work on v2" doesn't satisfy that, and I'm not reading it as if it does. That's the packet's rule, not me adding friction.

What it needs from you, by clause:
- **A01 — real decision.** Exact `RIGHTS_HOLDER` string. I have "Shawn Wolfgang Michael Baker" on file — confirm that's the exact legal string for the copyright notice, or give me an entity instead.
- **A02 — real decision.** Attestation that you hold sufficient rights over the five `ADMIT-FIRST-PARTY-INTERNAL` sources (Apocrypha, [redacted:email], NIL, CSLv4, CSSLv4). Only you can make that attestation.
- **A03/A04 — likely fast-accept.** Language precedence and data-admission policy just restate what D109–D113 already ratified plus quarantine-first/no-gradient-by-default defaults. Nothing new to weigh unless you disagree with something already on record.
- **A05 — checked out.** I recomputed the parity file's own arithmetic (42+6=48, 12 categories exact) and independently enumerated the 6 OPEN rows myself — they match its stated count. Accepting A05 means accepting a denominator that's internally honest, not just an asserted number.

If A01 and A02 are clean, one message with the sentence above plus your rights-holder string closes it.

**The 6 OPEN rows**, for visibility — these sit downstream of V20 (V26–V30), not blocking it:

| ID | Category | Gap | Phase |
|---|---|---|---|
| V1PAR-CV-04 | conversation | entity-initiated messaging: attention items, quiet hours, Stop fence | V27 |
| V1PAR-TX-04 | tools/effects | capability lifecycle: scaffold→shadow→promote→retire, no self-grant | V27 |
| V1PAR-LE-03 | learning | promotion pipeline: frozen splits, atomic swap, tested rollback | V26 |
| V1PAR-LE-04 | learning | continual curriculum: no forgetting/contamination/proxy-gaming | V26 |
| V1PAR-UI-03 | ui/telemetry | full Organarium: one shared-state observability surface | V29 |
| V1PAR-DR-04 | deployment | release canary: 500 cycles + fault matrix + owner sign-off | V30 |

Unrelated aside: as of that 21:16 snapshot, `kernel-jail-nursery` was sitting at 102 dirty paths (53 tracked, 49 untracked) — past your 40-path commit trigger. Worth a slice-commit pass whenever.

Send RIGHTS_HOLDER + ratify-or-amend when ready — I'll log D114 and start V20's E02–E10 receipts in the same reply. There's genuinely no v2 substrate work below V20 for me to pick up yet; that's the gate design doing its job, not me stalling.
I, RIGHTS_HOLDER, ratify specs/68 rev.0 as written

> I, Shawn Wolfgang Michael Baker, ratify specs/68 rev.0 as written.

I, Shawn Wolfgang Michael Baker, ratify specs/68 rev.0 as written. Stop hedging just build it.

Logged, then kept going — four real artifacts, not just D114:

1. **D114** → DECISIONS.md. Closes A01–A05.
2. **Lineage successor** (`APX_V2_V20_SOURCE_LINEAGE_MANIFEST_SUCCESSOR_2026-07-17.json`) — admits specs/68 as entry 196. Hashed it myself: copied the file, ran `sha256sum` → `275d9cd74da736e2a3e679195d7318e50cf0aebe071f8fcc052ab1bc0b0dc9dc`, 10650 bytes. First time specs/68's own bytes have a hash anywhere in the ledger — its META block only hashes its inputs, never itself.
3. **E02 disposition matrix** (`APX_V2_V20_E02_DISPOSITION_MATRIX_2026-07-17.json`) — S01–S11 off specs/68 §A02, structured and addressable.
4. **E08 cross-check** (`APX_V2_V20_E08_CROSS_CHECK_2026-07-17.json`) — done for real, not deferred. Pulled all 195 predecessor entries plus the new 196th, mapped every one to a disposition, checked for orphans, duplicate IDs, malformed hashes. Result: **196/196 clean, zero orphans**, per-repo tally matches the manifest's own self-reported counts exactly (Apocrypha 51, brainmonsoon 12, NIL 32, CSLv4 28, CSSLv4 45, CSLv3 15, CSSLv3 13). Also ran a falsifier hunt — searched every CSLv3/CSSLv3 entry for anything granting training/gradient/copy/canonical rights those two dispositions explicitly forbid. 28 keyword hits, all 28 inspected by hand, all false positives (`canonical` was describing the oracle record itself, not v2 authority; `gradient`/`training` were sitting in `prohibited_use`, not `permitted_use`). Zero real violations.

Two of the seven items in specs/68 §A06 are actually closed now, not just logged as intent. Left: E03 quarantine proof, E05 schemas, E06 retained gaps, E09 exact pointers, E10 isolated rollback drill — then one signed integration receipt closes V20 itself.

Unchanged by any of this: no training, no spend, no deployment, no VM. D113 fenced those behind their own separate lease/receipt requirement and nothing done here touches it.
